manifest.name: dsh-skill-manager
manifest.description: Skill manager for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a settings-page panel to enable/disable skills; disabled skills are hidden from every agent runtime discovery path (catalog injection, skill tool, /name invocation) while staying visible and restorable in the management list. Ships as a dsh bundle (auto-mounted patch layer) with a plugins-page management card.

bundle.text:
# dsh-skill-manager — bundle patch layer.
#
# This file is the package's `dsh.bundle.patch` (declared in package.json).
# When the package is listed in the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` (added via
# `dsh plugin add`, or by `pnpm add` + `dsh plugin reconcile`), this layer is
# applied automatically at boot — the user's own cordis.patch.yml must NOT
# duplicate the row below.
#
# The row mounts the host half as a loader entry; the client settings page
# loads automatically via the package's `dsh.client` declaration. No manual
# editing of the profile is needed after installation.
- insert:
    - id: skill-manager
      name: dsh-skill-manager

readme.text:
> [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）的 Skill 管理插件：在 Web GUI 设置页启停 Skill，停用的 Skill 在 Agent 运行时不会被发现。

[](LICENSE)

**English** · [English README](README.en.md)

适用于 DSH `0.1.0-rc.7` 及以上的 **bundle 插件模型**（`dsh.profile.bundles` + `dsh.bundle.patch`）。

- **设置页管理面板**：设置（Settings）→「Skill 管理」，列出全部 Skill（名称 / 描述 / 来源 / 仅用户调用标记），支持搜索与「全部 / 已启用 / 已停用」筛选，一键开关
- **批量操作**：工具栏「全部启用 / 全部停用」一键批量处理（停用全部需确认）
- **插件配置卡片**：设置 → 插件 →「插件配置」出现 dsh-skill-manager 卡片，实时显示启停统计与状态文件路径（服务端注册 settings 命名空间，rc.7+ keyed 分发）
- **运行时过滤**：停用的 Skill 对 Agent 完全不可见——目录注入（`<available_skills>`）、`skill` 工具调用、用户 `/name` 直接引用全部拦截，对所有 Agent 及子 Agent 全局生效
- **headless 兼容**：过滤是硬依赖（`skills`），webServer/agents 可选等待——无 Web GUI 的 headless profile 同样生效
- **目录自动更新**：已打开的会话会在下一步自动发布"目录已更新"替换消息，无需新开会话
- **全量可见可恢复**：停用只影响 Agent 运行时发现；管理列表始终显示全部 Skill，随时可重新启用
- **持久化**：禁用名单存于 `<harness home>/skill-manager.json`（默认 `~/.dsh/skill-manager.json`），重启后依然生效；已消失的 Skill 名会在下次列表加载时自动清理
- **零构建**：单文件插件（ESM host + ModuleLoader client），无编译步骤；`dsh.client` 声明随包自动加载客户端

将下面的提示词复制给你的 AI 助手（Agent），它会按照 [AGENT.md](AGENT.md) 完成安装：

> 请阅读仓库根目录的 AGENT.md 文档，按照其中的步骤，在当前 DSH profile 中完成 dsh-skill-manager 插件的安装、挂载与验证。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:welsione/dsh-skill-manager      # 直接从 GitHub 装

readme.section: 2) 重启 dsh 进程（bundle 补丁层启动时加载），刷新 Web 页面
readme.text:
```

> **git 依赖须知**：`github:…` 安装的是 GitHub 上**已提交**的代码——本仓库的
> v1.1.0+（bundle 声明）提交并 `git push` 之后才能用这种方式装到可用版本；
> 装到 1.0.0 旧包只会得到 "declares no dsh.bundle" 警告且不生效。
> pnpm 会把 git 依赖实体化为 profile 内的真实目录，并按 package.json 安装
> 其 `dependencies`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths`、`schemastery`），
> `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings` 为 peer 依赖，由 DSH 安装的扁平兜底目录提供。

readme.section: 2) 重启 dsh 进程（bundle 补丁层启动时加载），刷新 Web 页面
readme.text:
> 注意：`dsh plugin add` 会校验 `dsh.bundle` 声明并自动把包加入 profile 的
> `dsh.profile.bundles` 层——**不要**再往 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`
> 里手动添加本插件的 insert 行（会与 bundle 层重复挂载）。

| 文件 | 职责 |
| --- | --- |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 补丁层：`dsh.bundle.patch` 指向它，boot 时自动挂载 host 插件行 |
| `lib/index.js` | Host half（ESM）：包装 `skills` 注册表的 `list/snapshot/get` 过滤（`skills` 硬依赖 + webServer/agents 可选等待）；注册 HTTP API `GET /api/skill-manager/list`、`POST /api/skill-manager/set`（支持单/批量）；settings 命名空间注册；禁用名单持久化 |
| `lib/client.js` | Client half：`window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 注册设置页「Skill 管理」与「插件配置」卡片；把设置页导航的齿轮回退图标替换为书本图标 |
| `package.json` | `dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client` 声明（bundle + 客户端随包加载）；ESM；`@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings` peer 依赖 |

```bash
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3080/api/skill-manager/list | python3 -m json.tool
```

> Skill manager plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH): enable/disable skills from the Web GUI settings page; disabled skills are never discovered by agents at runtime.

[](LICENSE)

**English** · [中文 README](README.md)

Targets the **bundle plugin model** of DSH `0.1.0-rc.7` and later (`dsh.profile.bundles` + `dsh.bundle.patch`).

- **Settings-page panel**: Settings → "Skill 管理" lists every skill (name / description / source / user-only invocation badge) with search and "All / Enabled / Disabled" filters and one-click toggles
- **Batch actions**: "Enable all / Disable all" toolbar buttons (disable-all asks for confirmation)
- **Plugins-page card**: Settings → Plugins → "插件配置" shows a dsh-skill-manager card with live enable/disable stats and the state-file path (server-side settings namespace registration, rc.7+ keyed dispatch)
- **Runtime filtering**: disabled skills are completely invisible to agents — catalog injection (`<available_skills>`), the `skill` tool, and user `/name` invocation are all blocked, globally for every agent and subagent
- **Headless compatible**: filtering is the hard dependency (`skills`); webServer/agents are awaited optionally, so headless profiles without a Web GUI still get runtime filtering
- **Live catalog updates**: already-open sessions automatically publish a "catalog changed" replacement message on the next step — no new session needed
- **Always visible & restorable**: disabling only affects agent-runtime discovery; the management list always shows every skill, re-enable a

> push the repo first (v1.1.0+ carries the `dsh.bundle` declaration);

> pnpm materializes git dependencies as real directories inside the profile and

> the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings` peer dependency is served by the harness's

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch layer referenced by `dsh.bundle.patch`; mounts the host plugin row at boot |
| `lib/index.js` | Host half (ESM): wraps the `skills` registry's `list/snapshot/get` for filtering (`skills` hard-injected; webServer/agents awaited optionally); registers HTTP API `GET /api/skill-manager/list`, `POST /api/skill-manager/set` (single or batch); registers the settings namespace; persists the disabled list |
| `lib/client.js` | Client half: `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` registers the "Skill 管理" settings page and the plugins-page card; replaces the nav fallback gear icon with a book icon |
| `package.json` | `dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client` declarations (bundle + auto-loaded client); ESM; `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings` peer dependency |
